project: Conan — Claude Code dashboard (v4: QA polish + live in-cwd app preview)
description: v4 folds the six items QA logged against the shipped v3 build (docs/v4-backlog.md) into a fresh build loop: finish the shadcn migration v3 started, make the Context widget and permission flow honest, relocate Pulse, and add the marquee feature — run the project in Conan's current cwd and see it rendered live via a same-origin reverse proxy (Replit-style, not WebContainers). Decisions + re-verified anchors: docs/v4-research.md. Stories are dependency-ordered (shared components -> consumers; backend -> proxy -> UI) and sequenced to avoid migrate-then-rewrite churn.

userStories.title: Extract shared UI patterns into reusable components (SortToggle, status dot, two-tier card, time-ago, scope badge)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need v3's repeated bespoke patterns lifted into shared components so the rest of v4 (transcript sort, shadcn migration, widgets) consumes one implementation instead of copies.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract SortToggle (currently a private function in ActivityTimeline.tsx:319-339, with SortDir type at :313) into a shared component module under ui/src/components/ (e.g. shared/SortToggle.tsx) and re-wire ActivityTimeline to import it — no behavior change to the timeline

Componentize the remaining repeated patterns named in v4-backlog item 2: a status dot, the two-tier card shell (bg-muted shell + bg-card inner), a time-ago label, and a scope badge — each as a small shared component using semantic tokens only
Replace at least the existing inline duplicates of these patterns with the shared components so adoption is real (not just new files sitting unused)
No visual regression in ActivityTimeline or any component touched
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill that the timeline sort toggle and any restyled cards/badges render unchanged
userStories.notes: Foundation for US-002 (transcript sort reuses SortToggle) and the shadcn slices. SortToggle is NOT currently exported. Keep semantic theme tokens only. Suggested skills: shadcn, frontend-design, automate-browser.

userStories.title: Transcript view: newest/oldest-first sort toggle (reuse shared SortToggle)

acceptanceCriteria: TranscriptViewer.tsx (renders state.messages in fixed order at ~:33, no sort UI) gains a sortDir state defaulting to newest-first (desc)
Use the shared SortToggle extracted in US-001 — do not re-implement it
Display order reverses with the toggle, with a stable tie-break on ts then uuid
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill that toggling reorders transcript messages and defaults to newest-first
userStories.notes: v4-backlog item 5. Default newest-first per the ask (latest turn on top). Depends on US-001. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

When a transcript usage block exists, the widget renders the total context % (readContextUsage in src/transcript/index.ts:220-255, fallback session.context_tokens) instead of blank

Migrate PendingApprovals approve/deny controls to ui/button as part of this rewrite (this is where item 2's PendingApprovals migration lands)
Typecheck passes

acceptanceCriteria: For a prompt belonging to an interactive/observed session (not in byLaunchId, so unreachable by decidePermission's stdin path), resolve the matching pty via src/terminal/correlate.ts + the terminal_session.session_id link
Inject the chosen option as keystrokes (option index + Enter) into that pty so the TUI prompt is actually answered

listPendingPermissions (src/session/index.ts:805, currently byLaunchId-only) or the UI is extended so interactive-session prompts can be presented and routed to the correct terminal; clearly distinguish driven (stdin) vs interactive (keystroke) delivery
If no pty can be correlated, fall back to the honest non-deliverable state from US-008 (never claim success)
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: trigger a permission prompt in the docked interactive terminal, approve from the UI, and confirm the terminal prompt advances

userStories.title: Preview backend: dev-server process manager + dev-command discovery (src/preview/)
userStories.description: As a user, I want Conan to run the current cwd's dev server on demand, so the project I'm editing can be previewed live without me leaving the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Add src/preview/index.ts mirroring the pty/TermSession abstraction in src/terminal/index.ts (ring buffer of stdout, onExit handler, capped buffer) to spawn the project's dev command in getActiveCwd()
Discover candidate commands from the cwd's package.json scripts (default order dev -> start -> preview), exposed for the UI to pick/override per cwd

Pin the port: for Vite-style commands spawn with -- --port <free> --strictPort --base /preview/<id>/ --host 127.0.0.1; keep a stdout 'Local: http://localhost:NNNN' regex as the fallback for non-Vite tools
Subscribe to onCwdChange (src/cwd/index.ts) to stop/restart appropriately; the preview process lifecycle is DECOUPLED from the gateway watch restart (footgun #1)
Expose start/stop/status REST routes (authed like other /api routes) returning the chosen command, bound port, and run state
Typecheck passes
Start a real preview against a sample Vite project (or ui/) and confirm via the status route that it reports a bound port and running state
userStories.notes: v4-backlog item 6 (backend). v1 scope = run + proxy + preview, no container sandbox. Port-pinning preferred over stdout scrape (research). Suggested skills: typescript-expert, websocket.

userStories.title: Preview reverse proxy: /preview/:id mount + framing-header strip + HMR upgrade branch
userStories.description: As a user, I want the running dev server served same-origin inside Conan so it inherits auth, works under TLS, and frames cleanly — including hot reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Add http-proxy-middleware (pin v3) as the one new dep; mount a proxy at /preview/:id -> http://127.0.0.1:<devport> in src/gateway/index.ts (near the static/SPA serving at :740-742)
In the proxy's proxyRes, delete x-frame-options and strip frame-ancestors from CSP so the proxied page frames in an iframe

Build the proxy with ws:true and add a pathname.startsWith('/preview/') branch in the server.on('upgrade') router (src/gateway/index.ts:825-845) that calls wsProxy.upgrade(req, socket, head) — placed BEFORE the else socket.destroy() catch-all so it inherits the existing verifyUpgrade auth+Origin gate

Configure the spawned dev server (from US-010) so Vite HMR dials back through Conan's port: server.hmr.clientPort = Conan port, server.hmr.path under /preview/<id>/, protocol wss under TLS — injected via flags/env, not by editing the user's vite config
Confirm HMR works through the proxy (edit a file, see it hot-update in the proxied page) and does NOT silently fall back to dialing :5173 directly
Document the security floor: /preview/ HTTP relies on same-origin + loopback + the Origin-checked WS upgrade (an iframe src can't send x-conan-token) — note it in docs/ or a code comment
Typecheck passes
Load /preview/:id directly in a browser and confirm the dev page renders with working HMR
userStories.notes: v4-backlog item 6 (proxy + HMR). The two real gotchas (HMR fallback, framing headers) are solved in docs/v4-research.md. Depends on US-010. Editing src/gateway/* from an in-dock session triggers footgun #1 — run gateway with npm start (no watch). Suggested skills: websocket, typescript-expert.
